   "source": [
    "## lnferences and Conclusion\n",
    "\n",
    "- The analysis shows that Netflix has a significantly larger number of movies than TV shows, indicating that movies make up the majority of its content library.\n",
    "\n",
    "- The United States contributes the highest number of titles on Netflix, followed by India, making them the top content-producing countries in the dataset.\n",
    "\n",
    "- TV-MA is the most common content rating, followed by TV-14, suggesting that Netflix primarily targets mature and teenage audiences.\n",
    "\n",
    "- International Movies are among the most frequently occurring genre, followed by dramas and comedies.\n",
    "\n",
    "- The number of Netflix titles added increased significantly over the years.The highest number of titles were added around 2019.\n",
    "\n",
    "- Most movies have a duration of around 90–100 minutes. The longest movie in the dataset has a duration of 312 minutes.\n",
    "\n",
    "- The top director is Jan Suter with 21 title contributed towards netflix, followed by Raul Campos and Jay Karas.  "
   ]
